title: Figure 20: Wide-angle plasmonic absorber at 1550 nm - silver wire cell and impedance plot
description: Left: 3D rendering of the absorber unit cell showing red "Continuous Silver Wires" and "cut" silver wires inside a grey box, with dimensions labeled 20 nm, 50 nm, 80 nm, 320 nm and 250 nm. Right: plot of extracted permittivity and permeability (Re/Im ε and μ) versus wavelength (1450-1700 nm), with a circled crossing annotated "Impedance Matching". Caption: "Figure 20. Specific Design of a Wide-Angle Plasmonic Absorber Based on Negative Index Metamaterial Operating at λ=1550 nm."
